question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/949cb6aa00e9ed0fee792e0f054d04bfdf14b0b3aaf76a59e8caa52698a938a7.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

Step I: The 'image of square box' gets repeated in each next alternate boxes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8eba4f66a76ada95333209d4b4076daee007fe015c565a1c5d07e800b13b34d5.png] 

Step II: The letters are getting shifted its place and one circled letter is replaced with a new letter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5060662e2bbeb3dd7a16efe9c44c9a9da050457973e698b19ec73da6984c4f73.png] 

So, option 1 has complete the series.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
